theorem putnam_1995_a3
(relation : (Fin 9 → ℤ) → (Fin 9 → ℤ) → Prop)
(digits_to_num : (Fin 9 → ℤ) → ℤ)
(hdigits_to_num : digits_to_num = fun dig => ∑ i : Fin 9, (dig i) * 10^i.1)
(hrelation : ∀ d e : (Fin 9 → ℤ), relation d e ↔ (∀ i : Fin 9, d i < 10 ∧ d i ≥ 0 ∧ e i < 10 ∧ e i ≥ 0) ∧ (∀ i : Fin 9, 7 ∣ (digits_to_num (fun j : Fin 9 => if j = i then e j else d j))))
: ∀ d e f : (Fin 9 → ℤ), ((relation d e) ∧ (relation e f)) → (∀ i : Fin 9, 7 ∣ d i - f i) := by
  intro d e f ⟨hde, hef⟩
  have key : ∀ (x y : Fin 9 → ℤ), relation x y → ∀ i : Fin 9,
      7 ∣ digits_to_num x + (y i - x i) * 10 ^ i.1 := by
    intro x y h i
    have hy := (hrelation x y).mp h |>.2 i
    rw [show (fun j => if j = i then y j else x j) = fun j => x j + (if j = i then y j - x j else 0) from by
      funext j
      by_cases e : j = i <;> simp [e]] at hy
    simpa only [hdigits_to_num, add_mul, ite_mul, zero_mul, Finset.sum_add_distrib,
      Finset.sum_ite_eq', Finset.mem_univ, ↓reduceIte] using hy
  have A := key d e hde
  have B := key e f hef
  have hs : ∑ i : Fin 9, (digits_to_num d + (e i - d i) * 10 ^ i.1) = digits_to_num e + 8 * digits_to_num d := by
    simp only [hdigits_to_num, sub_mul, Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.sum_const,
      Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, Nat.cast_ofNat, Int.nsmul_eq_mul]
    omega
  have hsum : 7 ∣ digits_to_num d + digits_to_num e := by
    have h : 7 ∣ ∑ i : Fin 9, (digits_to_num d + (e i - d i) * 10 ^ i.1) := Finset.dvd_sum fun i _ => A i
    rw [hs] at h
    omega
  intro i
  have h1 : 7 ∣ (d i - f i) * 10 ^ i.1 := by
    rw [show (d i - f i) * (10 : ℤ) ^ i.1 = (digits_to_num d + digits_to_num e)
          - ((digits_to_num d + (e i - d i) * (10 : ℤ) ^ i.1) + (digits_to_num e + (f i - e i) * (10 : ℤ) ^ i.1)) from by ring]
    exact dvd_sub hsum (dvd_add (A i) (B i))
  exact IsCoprime.dvd_of_dvd_mul_right (IsCoprime.pow_right (by decide : IsCoprime (7 : ℤ) (10 : ℤ))) h1
